title: Skill Maturity Score
description: Per-skill maturity score derived from rolling duration + token-cost trends across validation runs. Declining trend = higher maturity; rising or persistent-failure trend = lower.

requirements.title: Trend computation service
requirements.description: Service that windows validation records by skill, computes rolling averages for duration_ms and tokens_used, derives a trend slope and a verdict-pass-rate, and combines them into a 0–100 score with documented weights.
